Supergoop!

Clear Winner

Pop Up Mob took Supergoop's Unseen Sunscreen to the streets of NYC with Clear Winner, a reflective guerrilla truck concept inspired by the product's invisible finish, designed to make clear SPF impossible to miss through high-volume sampling, branded treats, and a citywide moving billboard effect.
